news.title: Amazon to invest up to another $25 billion in Anthropic as part of AI infrastructure deal
news.snippet: Amazon's investment includes $5 billion into Anthropic now, with up to $20 billion in the future tied to certain commercial milestones. The initial investment is at Anthropic's latest valuation of $380 billion.

tech.title: AI Certifications & Skills 2026: Best AI & Machine Learning Courses, Certificates & Career Roadmap
tech.snippet: Employers are hiring for a mix of technical AI skills and high-value human skills. Certifications help you get noticed — but practical skills determine your salary, job role, and long-term growth.
